# Fix verification: ADR 0074 stage 1 (demand-driven content-anchor tracking)

**Change:** `.grimoire/adr/0074-demand-driven-content-anchor-tracking.md` — stage 1 only.
**Capture date:** 2026-10-20. **Base revision:** `8a92562` plus the previously recorded dirty tree
(see [`provenance.json`](provenance.json); machine/tool environment unchanged, see
[`../environment.json`](../environment.json)).
**Workloads:** `target/unicode-diagnosis/{original,no_vs16,wide_vs16}-2000.bin`, generated by
`scripts/profiling/unicode_diagnosis_input.py` (2000 rows, grid 107×32, default 1000-row history).
**Boundary:** `output_ingest_probe` ingestion only — no PTY, fonts, GPU or presentation.

## Method

The pre-change release binary from the diagnosis run (`target/unicode-diagnosis/output_ingest_probe-measured.exe`)
and a freshly built release binary of the changed tree were run back to back in the same session,
so the comparison is same-machine, same-workload and same-boundary. `row` chunking feeds one
input row per engine feed (the cadence a real ConPTY read loop produces); `4096` chunking is kept
as the microbenchmark cadence.

## Result

| Case (2000 rows, row cadence) | Before | After | Ratio |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `original` — parser + `Screen` | 4.08–4.42 s | 41.1–41.7 ms | ~99× |
| `original` — engine (`Terminal::process_output`) | 5.75–6.12 s | 41.3–43.1 ms | ~137× |
| `no_vs16` control — parser | 41.1–41.3 ms | 40.7–41.5 ms | unchanged |
| `no_vs16` control — engine | 2.05–2.42 s | 41.1–41.7 ms | ~52× |

The changed build makes the Unicode workload indistinguishable from the projection-free control at
both boundaries, which is exactly what the located mechanism predicts: the two trigger paths now
run only when an anchor consumer exists. The `no_vs16` engine case also collapses because its cost
was the per-feed reconciliation, not promotion.

## Tracked path is deliberately unchanged (stage-2 candidate)

`unicode_promotion_projection_cost` now registers an anchor consumer so it measures the retained
stage-2 problem instead of the fixed idle path:

```
case=original round=0 input_bytes=82000 grid=107x32 rows=2000 projection_calls=4000 projection_build_ns=4186575400 total_ns=4605167800
case=original round=1 input_bytes=82000 grid=107x32 rows=2000 projection_calls=4000 projection_build_ns=3752596200 total_ns=4083224500
case=original round=2 input_bytes=82000 grid=107x32 rows=2000 projection_calls=4000 projection_build_ns=3569932500 total_ns=3860518800
case=no_vs16 round=0 input_bytes=76000 grid=107x32 rows=2000 projection_calls=0 projection_build_ns=0 total_ns=42818200
case=wide_vs16 round=0 input_bytes=84000 grid=107x32 rows=2000 projection_calls=0 projection_build_ns=0 total_ns=41416700
```

With a consumer registered, promotion still costs 4000 builds (two per promoted row) and 3.57–4.19 s.
That is the unchanged interactive cost ADR 0074 explicitly does not promise to bound: a selection or
review anchor active while output streams still pays one rebuild per feed, and each promotion still
pays two. Stage 2 (maintained projection, line-scoped updates) needs its own measured decision.

## Regression guard

`content_anchor::diagnostics::idle_ingest_does_not_rebuild_the_content_projection` asserts, through
the existing build counter, that an untracked 200-row `❤️` burst produces **zero** projection builds
on both the parser/`Screen` and engine boundaries, and that the same ingest with a registered
consumer still builds (a live-counter control). Without that control the assertion would also pass
if the counter stopped observing the path.

## Gates

- `cargo test -p harbor-terminal --lib`: 1072 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo fmt --check`: clean.
- `cargo run --release -p harbor-terminal --example output_ingest_probe`: results above.

## Honest limits

- This is an ingestion-boundary measurement, not native acceptance. No ETW/WPR capture was taken,
  and no GUI/window responsiveness run was repeated after the change.
- No numeric acceptance threshold exists yet, so this reports a measured improvement, not a PASS
  against a calibrated budget. T0001's calibration and T0004's native acceptance still have to be
  re-run on this build; their previously measured values are now unrepresentative.
- Interactive cases (streaming output during an active selection or review) keep their previous
  cost by design; see the tracked-path section.
